mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user (user_name, user_id, user_password, user_email) VALUES (#{userName}, #{userId}, #{userPassWord}, #{userEmail})
mapper.select: SELECT user_name FROM user WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT a.al_name FROM user_allergy ua JOIN allergy a ON ua.al_num = a.al_num WHERE ua.user_num = #{userNum}
mapper.update: UPDATE user u JOIN user_privacy p ON u.user_num = p.user_num SET u.user_name = #{userName}, u.user_email = #{email}, p.up_gender = #{gender}, p.up_height = #{height}, p.up_weight = #{weight}, p.up_target_weight = #{targetWeight}, p.up_age = #{age}, p.up_act = #{act}, p.up_daily_kcal = #{dailyKcal}, p.up_daily_carbs = #{dailyCarbs}, p.up_daily_protein = #{dailyProtein}, p.up_daily_fat = #{dailyFat}, p.up_daily_natrium = #{dailyNatrium} WHERE u.user_num = #{userNum}
